name: get_map_key_status
title: Check FIRMS MAP_KEY usage
description:
How many FIRMS transactions the user's connected MAP_KEY has used in the current 10-minute interval, as reported by FIRMS (FIRMS allows 5,000 per interval; larger requests count as several), plus this server's own estimate and ceiling.

Use it when a request was refused for rate limiting, or before a large request (the whole world or 5 days with several sources). The key itself is never shown. Requires the user's FIRMS MAP_KEY to be connected.
